# # LINQ to Entities

The LINQ to Entities implementation of LINQ is an API that you can use to query data exposed by the EDM in a strongly typed way.

The following code snippet is an example of LINQ to Entities query:

```
WroxModel.WroxEntities context = new WroxModel.WroxEntities();
var result = from product in context.Products
select product;
foreach (var p in result)
Console.WriteLine(p.ProductName);
```

As you can see from this, the EDM is created, which allows the query to query the entities the same as other types of LINQ queries.
